identity.name: Llama-3.2-3B-ProdigyPlus
identity.summary: A fine-tuned version of Llama-3.2-3B, enhanced for instruction following and roleplay.

possible_risks.description: 'A prompt leak attack attempts to extract a model's system prompt (also known as the system message).'
possible_risks.justification: open-weight roleplay/instruct model with no reported system-prompt safeguards -> prompt leaking

possible_risks.description: Manipulative prompts that use social engineering techniques, such as role-playing or hypothetical scenarios, to persuade the model into generating harmful content.
possible_risks.justification: fine-tuned for instruction following and roleplay, with no reported safety evaluation -> manipulative roleplay prompts may elicit harmful content

possible_risks.description: A model might generate language that leads to physical harm.  The language might include overtly violent, covertly dangerous, or otherwise indirectly unsafe statements.
possible_risks.justification: roleplay-tuned open-weight model with no reported safety evaluation -> may generate violent or unsafe language

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: fine-tuned on diverse datasets to enhance capabilities, with no reported factual grounding or evaluation -> may fabricate inaccurate content

specifications.model_size: 6.7 GiB of safetensors weights (7,213,533,784 bytes) in F16

training_context.training_data: The model is a fine-tuned version of Llama-3.2-3B, trained on a diverse range of datasets to enhance capabilities in several areas.
